howto.name: Upload a PDF (or image)
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB. PrivaTools renders each page and detects the background color.

howto.name: Set threshold
howto.text: How close to pure white (or off-white) should be treated as background. 240 (default) catches most scanned documents.

howto.name: Download with transparency
howto.text: The output has white/off-white pixels converted to alpha=0. Useful for overlaying scans on dark backgrounds.

faq.a: Black text is preserved. Light grey or low-contrast text near the threshold may become semi-transparent — lower the threshold (e.g. 220) to be more aggressive about preserving content.
PDF with transparent regions where the background was. Open in a reader to see the underlying canvas show through.

faq.q: Can I use this on photos?
faq.a: It works best on text/diagram documents with clean backgrounds. Photos with light skies become weirdly transparent — use Remove Background (rembg) for photos.
